TRIP STYLE

Offshore & bluewater

Travel beyond the sheltered coast to fish open water. Trolling, casting and other methods depend on the target.

Find this style on the atlas ↗

Who it suits

Anglers comfortable with longer boat runs and changing sea conditions.

Boats & gear

A charter boat, suitable safety equipment and guide-selected tackle form the starting point. Confirm the run time and supplied equipment.

Seasons

Ask about the target’s local window and a weather alternative. A calendar month does not predict sea conditions.
